generation_notes: The object is interpreted as a simple open box (tray) with a rectangular window cut into the front face. The top view shows the double-line rim indicating wall thickness. The front view shows the window centered horizontally. The aspect ratio of the top view (1.47) and front view (2.73) are used to derive the 3D proportions.
